name: vaultgpt
description: Free ChatGPT power-extension workflows in a local-first Codex plugin with selected-chat capture, search, organization, prompt vaults, privacy review, and audit logs.

interface.shortDescription: Free ChatGPT power-extension features with local-first Codex workflows.
interface.longDescription: VaultGPT helps ChatGPT power users replace paid third-party browser extensions with free, Codex-native workflows for selected-chat capture, local search, unlimited organization, bulk export, prompt vaults, manual prompt chains, privacy review, and auditable provenance.
defaultPrompt: Use VaultGPT to show my available actions: save current ChatGPT tab, import export, search vault, export backup, prompt vault, and privacy review.
Use VaultGPT with @Chrome to preview saving the current active ChatGPT tab after privacy review. Do not save until I confirm.
Use VaultGPT to import an official ChatGPT export file into my local vault.
Use VaultGPT to search my local vault across saved chats, prompts, tags, and folders.
Use VaultGPT to export or back up selected vault items to Markdown, JSON, or ZIP with a provenance manifest.
Use VaultGPT to create or reuse a prompt with variables and optional manual prompt-chain steps.
